messages:
emma_lee: quick triage — need to lock down the "call result" transport for tool/function calling before roadmap freeze next Thu. customers have three asks: attachments (binary blobs), signed/verifiable results, and streaming partial outputs. propose an MVP + prioritized follow-ups.

raj_patel: agree on triage. my suggested scope: MVP = JSON envelope + artifact refs (pre-signed URLs or internal blob ids). no direct binary in the envelope. defer streaming and signing to follow-ups. avoids multipart pain and keeps SDK work small.

sofia_ng: +1. add explicit schema versioning on the envelope so we can evolve without breaking customers (e.g., "schema_version": "1.0"). also need telemetry hooks to measure fallback rates and artifact usage.

miguel_r: fintech customers will push for signed outputs. for MVP we can include an optional signature field but treat it as informational (not enforced). later phase: integrate with KMS and provide verified signatures as a policy.

priya_k: security note: if we accept artifact URLs in the envelope, we must define allowed schemes, TTL, and digest verification. signatures are doable but need canonicalization rules and threat-model review (replay, tampering). also require per-customer allowlists for which external tools are permitted to return artifacts.

raj_patel: technical detail: streaming partial tool results is complicated because tool calls are typically fire-and-return in our current runtime. two paths: 1) support chunked SSE/WebSocket for long-running tool calls; 2) keep call lifecycle synchronous in the API and send intermediate status updates as separate events (more work on infra but simpler for the API). I lean to postpone streaming to v2.

emma_lee: summarizing tradeoffs and suggested rollout: 
- MVP (v1): JSON envelope only. envelope contains tool name, args, result object, artifacts as array of refs (url, digest, size_bytes), and schema_version. no binary blobs, signature field allowed but ignored by platform.
- v1.1 (near-term): artifact TTL + digest verification + SDK helpers for upload/download. telemetry counters and eval hooks.
- v2: signed results (KMS integration), streaming partial outputs, direct multipart attachments for small blobs.

emma_lee: example MVP envelope (informal):
```json
{
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "pdf_renderer.render",
    "args": {"url": "https://..."},
    "result": {"status": "ok", "data": {"pages": 3}},
    "artifacts": [
      {"url": "https://s3.presigned/...", "digest": "sha256:abc...", "size_bytes": 234523}
    ],
    "signature": null
  }
}
```

sofia_ng: telemetry checklist (initial): emit metric tags: tool_name, customer_id, schema_version. metrics: tool_call.result.size_bytes, tool_call.artifact_count, tool_call.fallback_rate. also capture a small sample of result payloads for evals (opt-in for privacy).

miguel_r: SDK notes: add convenience methods: uploadArtifact(blob) -> {url,digest}, verifyArtifact(url,digest) and verifySignature(payload, signature, key_id). keep helpers so app devs don't implement ad-hoc validation.

priya_k: gating: do not flip-on artifact-url ingestion for Private deployments until threat-model review completes. signatures must pass crypto review before we allow auto-verify in SDK.

raj_patel: action items: I'll draft the spec doc (open PR) with envelope shape, artifact contract, and error modes (digest mismatch, expired URL, missing artifact). target PR by Fri EOD.

sofia_ng: i'll draft telemetry + eval rules and a small regression test harness for schema changes. target: next Wed.

miguel_r: i'll add SDK stubs and a demo for upload/verify. target: next Wed.

priya_k: i'll schedule the security/threat-model review. ping me when drafts are up.

emma_lee: owners set. we'll review in the Tue 10am sync — invite sent. priority: lock MVP envelope and gating criteria before freeze.
